headline: Women and Leadership: Looking Beyond the Global Health Crisis

headline: Don’t Fear the Robots, and Other Lessons From a Study of the Digital Economy
snippet: A task force assembled by M.I.T. examined how technology has changed, and will change, the work force.

headline: Artificial Intelligence Draws New Connections for Personalization
snippet: A start-up called Sentient could point a way to a future where sitting on a vast trove of data can be even more valuable than it is today.

headline: China’s Censors Misfire in Abuse-of-Power Case
snippet: The heavy-handed efforts to control the story of a fatal accident involving a police official’s son have been met with scorn.
